_meta.notes: SDF Procedural Plant Renderer configuration. Complete rewrite for C02 with organic fusion, Murray's law tapering, and distinct node type primitives.

max_nodes_per_plant.notes: Maximum nodes to render per plant

smin_blend_radius.notes: Smooth minimum blend radius for organic fusion between segments. Larger = more organic fusion, smaller = sharper joints.

raymarch_hit_epsilon.notes: Hit distance epsilon for raymarching termination

bounding_box_padding.notes: Padding around plant bounding box for raymarch start

l0_raymarch_steps.notes: Raymarch steps for LOD 0 (high quality, close)

l2_raymarch_steps.notes: Raymarch steps for LOD 2 (low quality, far)

root_aura_radius.notes: Radius of root highlight aura in Root Sight mode

own_root_highlight_color.notes: Highlight color for player's own roots in Root Sight (hex)

rival_root_highlight_color.notes: Highlight color for rival roots in Root Sight (hex)

leaf_size.notes: Leaf blade length in METRES for the WebGPU mesh builder (not an SDF unit): a 0.5 m seedling carrying a 1.2 m blade drew leaves wider than the plant. The SDF renderer does not read this key.

leaf_count_per_node.notes: Leaf blades instance per canopy node in the WebGPU mesh builder (0 disables foliage)

mesh_tube_radial_segments.notes: Radial segments around a mesh tube (C02b/MeshPlantRenderer).

mesh_tube_length_segments.notes: Length subdivisions along a mesh tube.

mesh_leaf_segments.notes: Segments used to draw one leaf blade.

mesh_joint_width_segments.notes: Width segments of the joint sphere that fuses two tubes.

mesh_joint_height_segments.notes: Height segments of the joint sphere that fuses two tubes.

mesh_max_leaves_per_node.notes: Ceiling on leaf blades drawn per node, so a dense crown stays affordable.

mesh_joint_scale.notes: Joint sphere radius as a fraction of the tube radius it fuses.

mesh_max_leaf_size.notes: Largest drawn leaf, in metres, regardless of node biomass.
